title: (Pseudo)-neoadjuvuant Gemcitabine based Chemotherapy with or without PD-L1-Immunecheckpoint Inhibitor versus upfront surgery in locally advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma – an international multicenter retrospective cohort study
summary: We aim to investigate, based on the available data, whether chemotherapy prior to the resection of an intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma improves survival.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm: Intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of already collected clinical data will be conducted. The study includes all patients who underwent curative resection due to intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The aim of the study is to investigate the impact of neoadjuvant chemotherapy on the outcome.
